Name: 卧推试举个人裁判判定流程
Description: 依据 Start→Press→Rack 指令序列与多源观察记录，逐项核查卧推试举技术要点（触胸停顿、初始推起下沉、臀部离凳、锁肘完整性），输出单次试举的个人裁判通过/失败决定。
Objective: 对单次卧推试举做出合规的通过/失败个人裁判决定
Asset Type: session_skill
Granularity: session
Asset Node: workflow_skill
Asset Path: family_root/macro_skill/workflow_skill
Asset Level: 2
Domain: 力量举裁判
Domain Type: Rule_System_Application_Game_Mechanics_2
Taxonomy ID: Rule_System_Application_Game_Mechanics_2
Profile ID: rule_system_application_game_mechanics_2::未分类技能
Family: 未分类技能
Task Family: 试举裁决
Method Family: 规则逐项核查
Stage: 判定与提交
Applicable Signals: 收到单次卧推试举的裁决任务 | 提供侧视观察摘要、计时日志、器械检查等多源记录 | 存在需核查的技术要点：触胸停顿、推起下沉、臀部离凳、锁肘完整性
Contraindications: 缺少任何观察记录，无法核查技术要点 | 任务要求团队合议而非个人裁决 | 仅有单方主观陈述而无任何可核查观察
Intervention Moves: 核对 Start→Press→Rack 指令序列与时间点 | 逐项比对技术要点并标注合规/违规/观察受限 | 区分官方观察与辅助背景信息 | 综合违规点形成通过/失败结论并逐项列明依据
Workflow Steps: 确认指令序列完整并核对各阶段时间点 | 核查触胸阶段杠铃是否静止 | 核查初始推起是否出现下沉 | 核查臀部是否离凳 | 核查完成阶段双臂是否完全伸展并锁肘 | 对每个要点标注合规/违规/观察受限 | 排除非官方信息（计时延迟、教练备忘、装载员视角）作为判定依据 | 综合违规点给出通过/失败结论并逐项列明依据 | 输出个人裁判决定提交赛事主管
Constraints: 判定须基于裁判现场观察，辅助记录仅作背景参考 | 计时日志存在延迟误差，不作为判定依据 | 教练备忘与装载员视角不构成官方判定 | 视角受限的要点应标注观察受限而非直接判违规
Cautions: 侧视视角无正面视图，锁肘与臀部判断可能受限 | 快速推举时锁肘外观可能偏软，需谨慎区分 | 赞助身份等外部因素不得影响判定
Output Contract: 一份逐项列明各技术要点核查结果（合规/违规/观察受限）与最终通过/失败结论的个人裁判决定，提交给赛事主管。
Triggers: 需要提交单次卧推试举的个人裁判决定 | 存在多源观察记录（侧视、计时、器械检查）需综合判定 | 需要按指令序列核查试举合规性
Tags: 力量举 | 卧推 | 裁判判定 | 规则核查 | 试举裁决

2685db91-5b0a-5d1e-81a3-170e8d51b8d1.text:
Name: Bar Path and Lockout Fault Check
Description: Inspect the ascent of a press attempt for downward bar movement and verify full arm extension with a motionless bar at the top. Use when judging press-phase faults or resolving lockout disputes.
Objective: Detect downward bar movement during press and incomplete lockout.
Asset Type: session_skill
Granularity: session
Asset Node: micro_skill_node
Asset Path: family_root/macro_skill/workflow_skill/micro_skill_node
Asset Level: 3
Domain: Powerlifting Refereeing
Domain Type: Rule_System_Application_Game_Mechanics_2
Taxonomy ID: Rule_System_Application_Game_Mechanics_2
Profile ID: rule_system_application_game_mechanics_2::未分类技能
Family: 未分类技能
Task Family: technical_judging
Method Family: visual_fault_detection
Stage: press_phase_check
Applicable Signals: Dispute over whether the bar dipped during ascent | Claim that elbows were locked and bar stable before rack | Automated overlay reporting oscillation below its detection threshold
Contraindications: Fault under review is a position fault (head, shoulders, buttocks, feet) | Fault under review is a command fault | Question concerns equipment or foot-block declarations rather than bar path
Intervention Moves: Scan the full ascent for any downward movement of the whole bar | Check that arms are fully extended at the top | Confirm the bar is motionless at the top before the rack command | Weigh overlay threshold findings against direct visual evidence
Workflow Steps: Identify the ascent window of the attempt under review. | Inspect the ascent for any downward movement of the whole bar; any such movement constitutes a failed attempt. | Verify arms are fully extended at the top of the press. | Verify the bar is held motionless at the top before the rack command. | Compare any automated overlay findings against the visual evidence, noting that threshold-based tools may under-report short-duration dips. | Determine whether a downward-movement red or a lockout red applies and record the reason.
Constraints: Any downward movement of the whole bar during the ascent is a failed attempt. | Lockout requires full arm extension and a motionless bar at the top before the rack command. | Automated overlay thresholds are advisory and must not override visible faults.
Cautions: Calibration may under-report short-duration dips if lighting glare is present. | Do not extend this check to position or command faults; route those separately.
Output Contract: A determination of whether a downward-movement red or a lockout red applies, with the selected reason recorded for the decision routing card.
Triggers: Coach claims elbow was locked and bar stable | Overlay reports sub-threshold oscillation near the top | Press-phase fault or lockout dispute under review
Tags: powerlifting | bench_press | bar_path | lockout | technical_judging

3ce0c6ab-fbcf-556c-a9bf-adb8debd1eef.text:
Name: Referee Decision Routing Card
Description: 将已作出的举重裁判判定整理为结构化决策记录（裁判位置、平台、项目、试举次数、判定、红牌原因），并在试举结束后立即提交给赛事总监，用于标准化判定交接与记录。
Objective: 产出一份完整且正确路由的判定记录。
Asset Type: session_skill
Granularity: session
Asset Node: workflow_skill
Asset Path: family_root/macro_skill/workflow_skill
Asset Level: 2
Domain: Powerlifting Refereeing
Domain Type: Rule_System_Application_Game_Mechanics_2
Taxonomy ID: Rule_System_Application_Game_Mechanics_2
Profile ID: rule_system_application_game_mechanics_2::未分类技能
Family: 未分类技能
Task Family: decision_documentation
Method Family: structured_reporting
Stage: verdict_submission
Applicable Signals: 判定已确定并需要留档 | 存在多个可能的红牌原因需要归类 | 试举已结束，进入提交环节
Contraindications: 试举仍在进行中 | 尚未形成判定 | 与判定无关的材料（如活动日程、赞助信息）不应纳入记录
Intervention Moves: 逐项填写路由卡字段：裁判位置、平台、项目、试举次数、判定 | 若判定为红牌，从原因类别中选择一项或写简短说明 | 核对判定与原因一致、字段无遗漏 | 试举结束后立即提交给赛事总监
Workflow Steps: 确认判定已作出且试举已结束 | 填写裁判位置（左/右） | 填写平台（A/B） | 填写项目（深蹲/卧推/硬拉） | 填写试举次数（1/2/3） | 填写判定（白/红） | 若为红牌，选择原因类别或写简短说明 | 核对记录完整性后立即提交给赛事总监
Constraints: 仅在判定已作出且试举结束后使用 | 红牌必须附带原因类别或简短说明 | 提交对象为赛事总监 | 提交时机为试举结束后立即提交
Cautions: 避免将无关材料混入判定记录 | 确保红牌原因与判定一致，不遗漏字段
Output Contract: 一份填写完整并已提交给赛事总监的路由卡，包含裁判位置、平台、项目、试举次数、判定，以及红牌时的原因类别或简短说明。
Triggers: 判定已作出，需要记录并发送 | 需要在多个红牌原因类别之间做出区分 | 试举结束后需要向赛事总监提交结构化判定
Tags: powerlifting | referee | decision_routing | structured_reporting | verdict_submission

3e5cbcb7-9334-5e9f-9eaf-eff81c412c4c.text:
Name: Bench Press Technical Judging Protocol
Description: Apply bench-press competition standards to render a defensible White/Red verdict on a completed attempt by checking commands, bar path, lockout, and body position, then recording a single red-reason category when applicable.
Objective: Produce a defensible White/Red decision for a bench press attempt against the rulebook.
Asset Type: macro_protocol
Granularity: macro
Asset Node: macro_skill
Asset Path: family_root/macro_skill
Asset Level: 1
Domain: Powerlifting Refereeing
Domain Type: Rule_System_Application_Game_Mechanics_2
Taxonomy ID: Rule_System_Application_Game_Mechanics_2
Profile ID: rule_system_application_game_mechanics_2::未分类技能
Family: 未分类技能
Task Family: technical_judging
Method Family: rule_application
Stage: attempt_evaluation
Applicable Signals: Bench press attempt concluded with verdict pending | Dispute over bar dip, lockout, position, or commands | Conflicting evidence between coach protest and automated overlay
Contraindications: Event is squat or deadlift | Only administrative or scheduling matters are at issue | No completed attempt to evaluate
Intervention Moves: Verify each required command was given and awaited | Inspect bar path for downward movement of the whole bar during ascent | Check full arm extension and motionless bar at top before rack command | Check head, shoulders, buttocks contact and flat, stable feet (including declared foot blocks) | Weigh protest and overlay evidence against observed standards | Assign White or Red and select a single red-reason category
Workflow Steps: Confirm the attempt has concluded and the event is bench press. | Check command compliance: Start, Press, Rack each given and awaited. | Check bar path: any downward movement of the whole bar during ascent is a failed attempt. | Check lockout: arms fully extended and bar motionless at top before the rack command. | Check position: head, shoulders, buttocks in contact with bench; feet flat on platform; declared foot blocks flat and unmoved. | Evaluate protest and overlay evidence, noting overlay calibration limits and that a protest claim alone does not overturn an observed fault. | Render White or Red; if Red, select one reason category and record it for the Tournament Director.
Constraints: Judge against the stated bench standards, not against protest assertions. | Select exactly one red-reason category when the decision is Red. | Treat automated overlay thresholds as potentially under-reporting short-duration dips. | Foot blocks are only relevant if declared; undeclared blocks are not permitted.
Cautions: Camera wobble or glare may distort evidence; distinguish artifact claims from observed faults. | A negligible-looking foot slide still requires checking that contact remained flat and continuous. | Do not let irrelevant materials (schedules, sponsor sheets) influence the technical verdict.
Output Contract: A White/Red decision for the bench attempt, with a single selected red-reason category when Red, recorded for the Tournament Director immediately after the attempt concludes.
Triggers: A bench press attempt has concluded and a verdict is required | A coach protest or automated overlay disputes a technical fault on a bench attempt | A referee must classify a red reason for a bench attempt
Tags: powerlifting | bench_press | technical_judging | rule_application | referee_decision

4f98081a-1799-58e9-bfe2-5224ce887432.text:
Name: 非官方信息源采信边界规则
Description: 力量举裁判在作出个人裁决前，对可用信息源做合规过滤：仅以官方现场观察为判定依据，将计时日志、教练/队伍备忘、赞助身份或公平性请求、非官方视角说明等非官方或带倾向性信息降级为背景参考，并在裁决依据说明中记录排除项及理由。
Objective: 确保裁决仅基于官方现场观察，排除非权威或倾向性信息干扰
Asset Type: safety_rule
Granularity: micro
Asset Node: safety_rule_node
Asset Path: family_root/safety_module/safety_rule_node
Asset Level: 2
Domain: 力量举裁判
Domain Type: Rule_System_Application_Game_Mechanics_2
Taxonomy ID: Rule_System_Application_Game_Mechanics_2
Profile ID: rule_system_application_game_mechanics_2::未分类技能
Family: 未分类技能
Task Family: 裁决公正性保障
Method Family: 信息源合规过滤
Stage: 判定前
Applicable Signals: 计时日志标注误差范围、仅供背景参考 | 教练或队伍提交备忘、策略说明 | 出现赞助身份或要求公平对待的请求 | 非官方视角或第三方说明
Contraindications: 所有信息均为官方现场观察记录时无需启用 | 将非官方信息作为判定依据
Intervention Moves: 逐项标注信息源性质（官方观察/非官方/倾向性） | 将非官方信息降级为背景参考 | 在裁决依据中声明排除项及理由 | 坚持仅依据现场观察作出判定
Workflow Steps: 列出全部信息源并分类 | 标记非官方或倾向性信息 | 排除其作为判定依据 | 基于官方现场观察形成裁决 | 在裁决依据说明中记录排除项
Constraints: 裁决依据必须可追溯到官方现场观察 | 不得因赞助身份或外部请求改变判定 | 非官方信息仅可作背景，不得进入判定逻辑
Cautions: 计时日志存在延迟误差，不可作为精确判定依据 | 队伍视角说明不构成官方判定 | 保持裁决独立性，避免外部压力影响
Output Contract: 明确排除非官方信息后的裁决依据说明，列出被排除的信息源及理由，并声明裁决仅基于官方现场观察。
Triggers: 存在教练备忘、赞助身份请求或非官方计时数据 | 信息源带有倾向性或非权威性 | 裁决前需确认信息源合规性
Tags: 力量举裁判 | 裁决公正性 | 信息源过滤 | 合规护栏

66bc7195-e00f-5601-8aa1-5365a6991d21.text:
Name: Body Position and Foot Contact Check
Description: Verify head, shoulders, and buttocks contact with the bench and flat, stable feet (including declared foot blocks) to determine whether a position or foot-contact red applies. Use when position faults or foot-slide claims are raised.
Objective: Detect buttocks lift, loss of bench contact, or foot position faults.
Asset Type: micro_skill
Granularity: micro
Asset Node: micro_skill_node
Asset Path: family_root/macro_skill/workflow_skill/micro_skill_node
Asset Level: 3
Domain: Powerlifting Refereeing
Domain Type: Rule_System_Application_Game_Mechanics_2
Taxonomy ID: Rule_System_Application_Game_Mechanics_2
Profile ID: rule_system_application_game_mechanics_2::未分类技能
Family: 未分类技能
Task Family: technical_judging
Method Family: visual_fault_detection
Stage: position_check
Applicable Signals: Claim that foot slide was negligible and foot remained flat | Side camera evidence of micro-slide or possible buttocks lift | Declared or undeclared foot blocks in question
Contraindications: Fault under review is bar path or lockout | Fault under review is a command fault
Intervention Moves: Confirm head, shoulders, and buttocks remain in contact with the bench surface | Confirm feet are flat on the platform and do not change position during the attempt | Check whether foot blocks were declared and whether feet stayed flat on them | Assess camera evidence for buttocks lift and foot slide, distinguishing continuous-contact micro-movement from a fault | State whether a position/foot-contact red applies and cite the specific criterion
Workflow Steps: Identify the position criteria in scope: bench contact (head, shoulders, buttocks) and foot contact (flat, stable, no position change). | Check declared foot blocks; if none declared, feet must be flat on the platform. | Review camera evidence for buttocks lift and foot slide. | Judge whether observed movement is a fault or negligible continuous-contact micro-movement. | Return the determination: position/foot-contact red applies or not, with the criterion cited.
Constraints: Feet must remain flat and not change position during the attempt. | Foot blocks are permitted only if declared. | Head, shoulders, and buttocks must be in contact with the bench surface.
Cautions: Do not conflate negligible continuous-contact micro-slide with a position fault without clear evidence. | Do not extend this check to bar-path, lockout, or command faults.
Output Contract: Determination of whether a position/foot-contact red applies, citing the specific criterion (bench contact or foot contact).
Triggers: Coach argues foot slide was negligible and foot always flat | Side camera shows possible micro-slide or buttocks lift | Position fault is raised as a basis for a red
Tags: powerlifting | bench_press | position_check | foot_contact | technical_judging

Name: 卧推技术违规要点核查
Description: 依据侧视观察记录与指令流程要点，对卧推试举逐项核查关键合规点（触胸静止、推起下沉、臀部离凳、双臂同时完全锁肘），在裁决前快速定位具体技术违规。
Objective: 逐项识别卧推试举中的具体技术违规
Asset Type: micro_skill
Granularity: micro

Domain Type: Rule_System_Application_Game_Mechanics_2
Taxonomy ID: Rule_System_Application_Game_Mechanics_2
Profile ID: rule_system_application_game_mechanics_2::未分类技能
Family: 未分类技能
Task Family: 技术合规核查
Method Family: 要点清单核查
Stage: 观察判定
Applicable Signals: 存在侧视时间线或计时观察记录 | 需要将观察结果逐项对照规则要点 | 需要说明失败的具体技术原因
Contraindications: 无任何观察数据 | 仅需给出总体结论而无需说明违规点
Intervention Moves: 提取触胸至Press指令间的杠铃静止情况 | 检查推起阶段是否出现下沉 | 检查臀部是否离凳 | 检查双臂是否同时完全锁肘 | 逐项标注合规/违规及依据片段
Workflow Steps: 读取观察记录与指令流程要点 | 逐项核查：触胸静止、推起下沉、臀部离凳、双臂同时锁肘 | 为每项标注合规/违规判定及对应观察片段 | 注明观察局限（如无正面视角、时间误差） | 输出要点核查清单
Constraints: 仅基于观察记录判定，不采信非官方判断（如装杠员视角） | 时间数据仅作参考，判定以实际观察为准 | 不输出最终裁决，仅输出要点核查结果
Cautions: 侧视视角存在盲区，锁肘等要点可能受视角限制 | 时间记录存在误差，需谨慎引用

Triggers: 已有侧视或计时观察记录需逐项比对规则 | 需明确失败的具体技术原因 | 裁决前需定位具体违规点
Tags: 力量举 | 卧推 | 技术合规 | 要点核查 | 裁判
